city.en: Vienna (OPEC HQ; may be held by video)
city.zh: 維也納（OPEC總部；可能以視訊舉行）

next_meeting.note: Date set by the 41st ONOMM (7 Jun 2026). Format/venue not stated; recent OPEC+ meetings were virtual. Seven-country group also meets 29 Nov.

summary.en: The UAE announced in April 2026 that it would leave OPEC and OPEC+ from 1 May 2026, saying it wanted freedom to produce more oil.
summary.zh: 阿聯於2026年4月宣布自5月1日起退出OPEC與OPEC+，表示希望能自由增產石油。

question.en: Does a cartel get weaker when a big low-cost producer leaves?
question.zh: 當一個低成本的大產油國退出，卡特爾會因此變弱嗎？

title.en: OPEC+ holds output steady amid Gulf disruption
title.zh: 海灣供應受擾，OPEC+維持產量

summary.en: On 1 November 2026 seven OPEC+ countries kept December output targets unchanged while conflict in the Middle East continues to curb supply.
summary.zh: 2026年11月1日，七個OPEC+國家維持12月產量目標不變，中東衝突持續限制供應。

question.en: Why might producers keep quotas unchanged when prices are pushed up by supply disruptions?
question.zh: 當供應中斷推高油價時，產油國為何仍可能維持配額不變？

title.zh: 產能評估將決定2027年基準

summary.en: OPEC+ ministers want assessments of each country's maximum sustainable capacity completed to serve as production baselines for 2027, a key issue for the 29 November meeting.
summary.zh: OPEC+部長要求完成各國最大可持續產能評估，作為2027年產量基準，這是11月29日會議的關鍵議題。

question.en: Why do countries argue so much about how their 'capacity' is measured?
question.zh: 為什麼各國對「產能」如何衡量爭議這麼大？

Declaration of Cooperation creates OPEC+ with Russia and others
text.zh: 合作宣言成立OPEC+（含俄羅斯等）

text.en: Record OPEC+ output cuts during COVID-19
text.zh: 新冠疫情期間OPEC+創紀錄減產
